method: Four-neighbour minimax connected fill above a smoothed DEM river-line reference

continuous_map_raster.threshold_encoding: 16-bit value in red and green PNG channels, decoded linearly to 0-8m

stream_ribbon.basis: illustrative buffer around mapped Chenab centerline; not measured channel width

assumptions.river_reference: 10th percentile DEM within 300m of river samples every ~60m; 17-sample median then sigma=4 Gaussian; nearest reference sample
assumptions.seed: OSM river centerline rasterized with all_touched; seed height zero only
assumptions.baseline: Connected cells at relative rise 0; excluded from incremental footprint and population
assumptions.canals: Context only; never seeded or artificially lowered
assumptions.population: Native WorldPop count multiplied by exact UTM polygon intersection fraction; uniform within native pixel
assumptions.playback: Continuous presentation sequence, not flood arrival or travel time
assumptions.paths: Representative minimax parent-tree connections; not mapped streams or hydraulic flow vectors

dem.vertical_reference: Provider EGM2008 heights; not station gauge datum

limits: Surface model includes vegetation and structures; no surveyed channel bathymetry.
No flow conservation, rainfall-runoff, inflow hydrograph, roughness, culvert or levee inventory.
Sub-metre increments are sensitivity inputs, not accuracy claims.
No observed flood extent validation; not an operational warning or safety tool.
Study-edge truncation and NoData can alter connectivity.
